long_biography.plain_text:
Stratakis built his career in Greek shipping through business development at A.M. Nomikos. The Athens-based company manages dry-bulk and container vessels for owning entities, combining commercial, corporate and technical services. His role connected market relationships with the operational performance expected by charterers and counterparties.

He became a spokesman for the company when 19 of its ships received United States Coast Guard Qualship 21 status. Stratakis framed the recognition around reliable service, fewer avoidable port delays and a continuous focus on safety. He also serves on the Baltic Exchange's European advisory council for dry markets. The council gives Baltic members a forum to advise on dry-market indices and products.
